summary: Frontend-only verification of Analitik tab refinements (iteration 11): (1) new combobox-style Reagen filter replacing dual search+select, (2) Ceklis Semua/Uncek Semua buttons in Custom comparison popover, (3) Unduh PNG buttons on both trend and comparison charts. All 3 features work correctly. Dark mode legible. Backend not tested (no changes this round).

test_results.trend_combobox: PASS - single button data-testid=analitik-reagen-select shows 'Semua Reagen'; opens popover with search + 97 options (all + 96 reagens); typing 'a' filters to 81 options live; selecting 'AIM Dengue NS1' closes popover, updates trigger label to 'AIM Dengue NS1', chart re-renders; no separate always-visible search input remains
test_results.ceklis_semua_uncek_semua: PASS - filter 'a' → 80 options visible; Ceklis Semua checks all 80 filtered items → custom button label '80 reagen dipilih'; clearing filter then Uncek Semua resets label to 'Pilih Reagen' and shows analitik-comparison-custom-empty prompt
test_results.unduh_png_trend: PASS - download event captured with filename 'tren-pemakaian-Semua Reagen.png'; success toast 'Grafik diunduh sebagai PNG' displayed; button not disabled when chart has data
test_results.unduh_png_comparison: PASS - download event captured with filename 'perbandingan-pemakaian-reagen.png'; button not disabled in Top 5 mode
test_results.regression_filtering: PASS - selecting a reagen updates trend chart title/data; Top 5 mode renders comparison bar chart independently of trend selection
test_results.dark_mode: PASS - combobox popover, search input, list items, and Unduh PNG buttons all legible in dark mode (verified via screenshot)
test_results.sidebar_regression: PASS - Analitik visible at position 1 for petugas role (kalgen); Kelola Pengguna/Pengaturan not shown

critical_code_review_comments: downloadChartPng filename 'tren-pemakaian-Semua Reagen.png' contains a space - acceptable but consider slugifying reagen name for cleaner filenames on strict filesystems.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_11 fully verified the 3 Analitik UI refinements (combobox reagen picker, select-all/clear-all in custom comparison, PNG export on both charts). Backend unchanged - iteration_10 pytest results still valid. If future changes touch Analitik, re-run the interactions in this report.
